# CoreVideo

**Symbols:** 11.2% of Apple's iOS API (100 of 889, exact) · **Rows:** 9: 6 ✅ 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 4.0+

**Area:** [Graphics & text](../COVERAGE.md#graphics) · **Apple:** [Core Video](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corevideo) · **Issues:** [`area:graphics`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agraphics)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** `CVPixelBuffer` and pools in main memory (`isim/swift/overlays/CoreVideo.swift`). Rows for the Swift API: [CoreMedia](CoreMedia.md).
- **C interface:** `CoreVideo.framework` (`<CoreVideo/CoreVideo.h>`, headers in `isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/CoreVideo`) re-exports the overlay; its functions are `@_cdecl` wrappers in `isim/swift/overlays/CoreVideo+CInterface.swift` and its keys `CFSTR` constants in `isim/frameworks/CoreVideo`. A `CVPixelBufferRef` is the Swift `CVPixelBuffer`, so C, Swift, AVFoundation and Vision share buffers.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CVPixelBufferCreate`, `CVPixelBufferCreateWithBytes`, getters (width, height, pixel format, bytes per row, data size, planes), `CVPixelBufferRetain` / `Release`, `CVPixelBufferGetTypeID`, from C | ✅ | 4.0 | adapted: main memory, no IOSurface; `pixelBufferAttributes` ignored on create. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC) |
| `CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress` / `UnlockBaseAddress`, `CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddress(OfPlane)` | ✅ | 4.0 | adapted: the memory is always mapped; locking only checks its argument. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC: write rows, read back) |
| `CVPixelBufferCreateWithPlanarBytes` (Swift and C) | ✅ | 4.0 | bi-planar formats (`420v`, `420f`) over the caller's planes; the release callback gets the plane addresses. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC) |
| `CVBufferSetAttachment` / `GetAttachment` / `CopyAttachment` / `HasAttachment` / `RemoveAttachment` / `RemoveAllAttachments`, `CVBufferGetAttachments` / `CopyAttachments` / `SetAttachments`, `CVBufferPropagateAttachments`, `CVAttachmentMode` (Swift and C) | ✅ | 4.0 | adapted: kept with the buffer; propagation copies the `shouldPropagate` ones. `kCVImageBuffer…` colour keys and values. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC) |
| `CVPixelBufferPoolCreate`, `CVPixelBufferPoolCreatePixelBuffer`, `GetAttributes`, `GetPixelBufferAttributes`, `Retain` / `Release`, `Flush` (C) | ✅ | 4.0 | adapted: every buffer is new (no reuse; `Flush` does nothing); width and height are required. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC) |
| `CVReturn` codes, pixel format constants, `kCVPixelBuffer…Key` | ✅ | 4.0 | the same values as Apple's. Tested (HelloQuartzCoreObjC) |
